description: The dynamic value for a dynamic pseudo-type parameter hides a null argument after it
notes: The spec checks every argument, and a null for a parameter that doesn't accept null makes the call erroneous, so this is an error, as it is with the arguments the other way around (native/types/function-null-argument-before-dynamic-argument-is-error). go-cty stops checking the arguments at the first one of the dynamic pseudo-type whose parameter doesn't accept that type, and returns the dynamic value (Function.returnTypeForValues in cty/function/function.go). hashicorp/hcl has already converted the arguments, so this only happens for parameters whose type is the dynamic pseudo-type.
